$comment: One entry per building. `home: true` is the user's own building — the dashboard defaults to it. `adapter` names a module in scraper/adapters/. For the sightmap adapter, find the id by grepping the building's floorplans page for 'sightmap.com/embed/<id>'. `concession` points at the marketing banner (url + CSS selector) — concessions aren't in any unit feed, they're a banner on the building's own site.
